name: El Farol: mean attendance against capacity
description: Challet, Marsili and Ottino: convergence of the mean to the capacity is trivial. Mean attendance over rounds 201–2 000 against the capacity L, for Arthur's agents and for agents going at random with probability L/100. Measured (release, seeds 1–10, recorded 2026-09-27): Arthur's agents 21.9, 31.1, 40.1, 48.9, 59.1, 67.9, 77.1 at L 20 to 80; random agents 19.9–80.0, within 0.1 of L every time. The inductive agents track L roughly; the random ones exactly.
